scope: Source-gated negative control, held-out dataset response, assumed-label sensitivity. User approved starting these experiments after proposal.

source_gate.features: 48 pooled feature mean/std/range/absolute frame difference, record mean; no age, GDI or ID input
source_gate.classifier: train-only StandardScaler + LogisticRegression C1 max_iter2000 seed20261105, equal-person and equal-source loss
outputs: hard: source probability>=0.5 =>100, otherwise original Stanford GDI prediction
source_gate.interpretation: Explanatory control, not a validated clinical model. Source predictability alone does not establish shortcut use.

external.models: original adult-only LJMU64 experiment CNN/STT refit five folds, before and after addition
external.aggregation: average five frozen model outputs per record-side, then equal-person; also retain fold results
external.calibration: original stored training-only coefficients, no fitting to LIVE
external.labels: unlabeled, no MAE or clinical GDI claim
external.adult_candidate: MoVi strict side-view intervals have zero124-frame windows; excluded without time stretching or looping
external.limitations: LIVE previously explored in this project, but never in these checkpoints; cross-source plus age change, not a newly untouched final test

sensitivity.cohort: same LJMU adult9 people12 records as A-D v3
sensitivity.reference: reuse running v3 B_adult label100 weight1; A is Stanford-only reference
sensitivity.sampling: exact same B_adult examples/order and updates; multiply external loss weights only; Stanford loss weights unchanged
sensitivity.calibration_selection: Stanford training only, frozen original per-fold epochs
sensitivity.evaluation: same Stanford all/actual-side>=90/>=100/<70; MAE, shortfall, bias, underprediction fraction, low-score overprediction; descriptive paired person bootstrap; no selecting best arm on these results
